newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds poised for recovery, small gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds poised for recovery, small gains seen.

text.p: Danish bond prices opened slightly higher on Tuesday and dealers predicted that the market would recover after Monday's falls with modest gains expected.

"The price fall stopped when the German bund future met technical resistance at 102 yesterday. This should point to recovery here today, rises will only be moderate but the downward trend is over," one dealer said.

The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 opened up 0.10 point from Monday's close at 113.20, yielding 5.98 percent. The forthcoming seven percent 2007 benchmark rose 0.09 point to 106.14 with yield at 6.17 percent.
The 2007's 10-year yield gap with Germany was unchanged from Monday's close to 54 bps. The crown opened at 3.8107 per mark, weakening a tad from 3.8100.
